units.raw_text: Designed and shipped the Threadline production-tracking schema and API. Single Postgres database, multi-tenant by row-level security, with a Drizzle ORM layer and a typed REST API generated from the schema. Schema has held through three pricing-model changes and a 40x customer growth without a major rewrite.

units.raw_text: Led the SOC 2 Type II program through a single-engineer-plus-vCISO model. Picked Drata for the evidence layer, ran the controls work in a sprint cadence, cleared the auditor's first walkthrough with zero exceptions, and got the report out three weeks ahead of the largest customer's procurement deadline.
